title: Defining Your ICP and Market Position
description: Practice identifying ideal customer profiles, crafting value propositions, and making competitive positioning decisions.

interactions.prompt: A B2B SaaS startup sees these trial-to-paid rates: SMBs 3%, Mid-market 14%, Enterprise 6%. Support tickets are 5x higher for Enterprise. What's the key signal?

options.text: Enterprise is too expensive to support
Mid-market is the strongest ICP based on conversion
SMBs should be abandoned immediately
The product needs more enterprise features

interactions.prompt: An Ideal Customer Profile describes the type of ____ most likely to buy and retain, while a buyer persona describes the individual decision-maker.

options.text: Company or account
Industry vertical
Geographic region
Marketing channel

interactions.prompt: You're launching a project management tool. Asana and Monday.com dominate the general market. You can either target all teams broadly with lower pricing, or focus narrowly on construction teams with tailored workflows.

options.text: Go broad with lower pricing to maximize addressable market
Focus on construction teams for defensible niche positioning
Build for both and let the market decide
Wait until competitors show a gap before choosing

interactions.prompt: Competitor analysis shows: Competitor A charges $50/seat (general HR), Competitor B charges $120/seat (enterprise compliance). Neither serves healthcare-specific compliance. Your product handles HIPAA workflows natively. What matters most?

options.text: Price your product between $50 and $120 per seat
The unserved healthcare compliance need is your positioning wedge
Competitor B's high price means the market is overpriced
General HR is the bigger market opportunity

chartData.title: Competitive Pricing Analysis by Market Segment

interactions.prompt: You're defining your ICP for a new expense management tool. Rank these steps in the correct order from first to last.

options.text: Write messaging that speaks to the ICP's pain points
Analyze which existing customers have highest retention and LTV
Identify common firmographic traits (size, industry, tech stack)
Validate the ICP hypothesis with 10-15 prospect interviews

interactions.prompt: Your value proposition testing shows: Message A ('Save 10 hours/week on reporting') gets 22% click-through. Message B ('The only analytics platform built for DTC brands') gets 15% click-through but 3x higher demo conversion. Which do you lead with?

options.text: Message A — higher click-through means broader market appeal
Message B — higher demo conversion signals stronger purchase intent
Combine both messages into one headline
Test five more messages before deciding anything

interactions.prompt: You're entering a new market with a cybersecurity product. Rank these positioning activities from most to least important for initial market entry.

options.text: Build a competitive battlecard against top 3 incumbents
Define your unique differentiator vs. existing solutions
Create a brand awareness campaign on social media
Identify the specific buyer pain point competitors underserve

interactions.prompt: Your largest competitor just launched a free tier targeting the same mid-market ICP you validated. Your paid product costs $30/seat/month. How do you respond?

options.text: Match with your own free tier immediately
Double down on differentiated value and target upmarket slightly
Cut price to $10/seat to undercut them
Pivot to a completely different customer segment

interactions.priorContext: You previously validated mid-market as your strongest ICP with 14% trial-to-paid conversion. Now the market leader has introduced a free tier directly targeting your segment, changing the competitive landscape.
